messages:
nina: quick ops-cheatsheet followup from the quant RFC — need minimal rollout steps for FP8/INT8/4bit.
arjun: risks: silent regressions + p95 spikes. proposal: ship tiny probe + three signals.
sam: signals: anchor EM, token-perp delta, p95 latency. each profile includes probe config.
maria: add 0.5% shadow for headwise checks. stash kv on trip.
nina: fallback rules: if (EM_drop >= 3% AND perp_delta >= 0.02) for 5m -> revert profile. if only latency +20% -> try batch-size bump then fall back to INT8.
sam: runbook (short): staging 24h @0.1% -> shadow A/B 48h -> canary 1% -> auto-revert if 2 signals fail -> capture kv+logs.
ops-bot: runtime flag `quant.probe.stash_kv` available in agent>=2.1.3. scheduled canary 2025-09-12T02:00:00Z.
